eyebrow: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing · Chapter 4, Lesson 17
subtitle: Overwrite the row, keep no history

caption: One row is overwritten in place — the old phone number leaves no trace.

code:
UPDATE d_Salesperson
SET    Phone = '555-6789'
WHERE  Salesperson_SK = 295;

-- No new row, no history —
-- 555-1234 is gone the moment this runs.
caption: A Type 1 update touches the existing row directly; nothing else changes.
